description:
TRIGGER: caller-supplied chain has an AIA-recoverable defect (e.g. missing intermediate → ChainBroken/NoTrustedPath/SignatureInvalid) AND the leaf or another cert is expired (or has any non-recoverable cert-level defect like NameConstraintViolation, KeyUsageMissing, PolicyViolation).

FLOW: Verifier::verify_one fast path runs pkix_path::validate_path. The 'cheap' defect (e.g. ChainBroken because intermediate is missing) surfaces FIRST because validate_path checks chain linkage before it does per-cert validity/EKU/etc. checks on every cert. is_aia_recoverable() says 'true' → slow path build_with_aia runs. AIA succeeds in fetching the missing intermediate, augments the pool, then pkix_path_builder::build_first_valid_path runs validate_path on the built chain. validate_path now sees the leaf is expired and returns Err. build_first_valid_path translates this to Error::NoValidPath{tried, last_error: String}, which build_with_aia propagates as Error::PathBuild(NoValidPath { ... }).

BAD BEHAVIOR: The error surfaced is Error::PathBuild(NoValidPath {tried: 1, last_error: 'validity period check failed at chain index 0'}) instead of Error::Path(pkix_path::Error::ValidityPeriod {index: 0}) that the fast path would have produced if the chain had been complete to begin with. Callers pattern-matching on Error::Path(_) — including the test e2e_verify_chain_default_expired_returns_validity_error and any downstream consumer doing the same — get a different variant for the SAME underlying cert defect depending on whether the caller happened to supply a complete chain or an incomplete one.

Worse, the inner pkix_path::Error is downgraded to a String inside NoValidPath, so callers cannot programmatically distinguish ValidityPeriod from NameConstraintViolation from PolicyViolation after a slow-path build. This is a real information regression introduced by PKIX-zkjb.7, not just a cosmetic variant difference.

FIX OPTIONS: (a) in build_with_aia, on NoValidPath, parse the inner string and translate back into a pkix_path::Error variant (brittle); (b) call pkix_path::validate_path before invoking the AIA loop on each candidate so we can capture the structured error (already done — but the structured error is lost when we route through build_first_valid_path); (c) bypass build_first_valid_path entirely when the only AIA-recoverable error was SignatureInvalid or NoTrustedPath and walk candidates manually; (d) document the behavior change and update is_aia_recoverable to NOT include any error variant whose retry might mask a cert-level defect.

The current AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 also names `Error` as a public result type that must be Clone+Debug+PartialEq+Eq+serializable. NoValidPath's String 'last_error' field is already a downgrade from a structured inner error to a Display string — it has the same root cause.
title: verify_one slow-path validity errors surface as PathBuild instead of Path(ValidityPeriod)
